name: CriticalControlVerificationHub
tagline: Bowtie critical controls, scheduled verifications and stop work – one plug-and-play Power Platform app for mining.
description: A complete critical control management module: material unwanted events with preventive and mitigating controls, critical control verifications scheduled by area and role, checklist verification with score, failed-control actions, stop work for failed preventive controls and effectiveness KPIs. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages with demo data out of the box.
features: Checklist per control with Yes/No/N/A and score
Configurable pass mark, windows, questions, labels, colour
Phone layout with bottom view bar
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
